body.name: Conditionally independent-calendar subclass
body.construction:
Define
\[
 \mathcal M^{\mathrm{iid}}_{N,T,\mathbf n}
 =\left\{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}:
 \text{for every \(s\) and \(P\)-almost every \(z_0\), the variables
 \(X_{s1},\ldots,X_{sT}\) are conditionally independent given \(z_0\)}
 \right\}.
\]
Independence is required only for the design sequence.  No independence across calendar dates is imposed on the responses within a unit history.
